senses.gloss: सेतिका f. An epithet of Ayodhyā.

सेतु m. 1. A ridge of earth, bank, causeway, dyke, तोयस्येव प्रतिहतरयः सैकतं सेतूमोघः Ut.iii., R.xvi.2; 2. a land-mark; 3. a bridge, स सेतुं बंधयमास प्लवगैर्लवणांभसि R.xii.70, xiii.2; 4. a pass, a defile, a mountain road; 5. a boundary, a limit; 6. a barrier, an obstruction of any kind, e.g. दुष्येयुः सर्ववर्णाश्च भिद्येरन् सर्वसेतवः; 7. an established institution, a fixed rule or law; 8. an epithet of the sacred syllable Om, मंत्राणां प्रणवः सेतुस्तत्सेतुः प्रणवः स्मृतः /Kālikā P./

सेतु-बंध m. 1. the forming of a causeway or bridge, e.g. जले गते वा किमु सेतुबंधः; 2. the ridge of rocks that extends from the south extremity of the Coromandel coast towards the Island of Ceylon, (supposed to have been built by monkeys for Rāma).
सेतु-भेदिन् (I) a. removing obstructions, breaking down barriers.
सेतु-भेदिन् (II) m. name of a tree (दंतीवृक्ष).
सेतुक m. A bank, a causeway, a bridge.
सेत्र n. A bond, a fetter.
